import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def task_func(num_groups=5, data_size=5, labels=None):
    if not isinstance(num_groups, int) or num_groups <= 0:
        raise ValueError("num_groups must be a positive integer")
    if not isinstance(data_size, int) or data_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("data_size must be a positive integer")

    if labels is None:
        group_labels = [f"Group {i + 1}" for i in range(num_groups)]
    else:
        if isinstance(labels, (str, bytes)):
            raise ValueError("labels must be a sequence of labels, not a single string")
        group_labels = [str(label) for label in labels]
        if len(group_labels) != num_groups:
            raise ValueError("labels length must match num_groups")

    rng = np.random.default_rng()
    data = rng.integers(1, 10, size=(data_size, num_groups))

    index_labels = [f"Item {i + 1}" for i in range(data_size)]
    df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=index_labels, columns=group_labels)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    x = np.arange(data_size)
    bottom = np.zeros(data_size)

    for label in group_labels:
        values = df[label].to_numpy()
        ax.bar(x, values, bottom=bottom, label=label)
        bottom += values

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(index_labels, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Items")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Stacked Bar Chart of Random Data")
    ax.legend(title="Groups")
    fig.tight_layout()

    filename = "test_plot.png"
    fig.savefig(filename)

    return fig, df, filename
